published_source: Printed Table 4, Panel A, column (2a) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2020.01838.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output in authors_code_* to the printed decimals. Printed N 149,874 differs from the code output N 149,138; coefficient and SE agree. Earlier: Article tables not available in the project (no data/text file). authors_code_* = output of the authors' Replicate.R line 741 on the shipped final data (README: the package reproduces all tables). Table/column labels follow the section comments in Replicate.R (unverified against the article).
replication_status: exact (fixest with the authors' FE reproduces Replicate.R line 741: 0.202640 vs felm 0.202640, SE 0.098082 vs 0.098082, N 149138; article table unavailable)
notes: Kang (2025), 'Price-Fixing Cartels and Firm Innovation', Management Science 71(11). Package: Replicate.R + final cleaned/merged .rds files (real processed data; raw DOJ/VitalLaw, PatentsView and licensed Compustat not shipped). FE: unit + 4-digit-NAICS (patents) or Compustat industry group (R&D) x year (authors: felm(... | assignee_id + paste0(cl, year) | 0 | cl)); here xt_vars = naics4 (= cl) so the time FE is year + year x cl; SE clustered by cl. No controls, no weights. Outcomes are IHS-transformed counts/amounts, precomputed as ihs_* (log(x + sqrt(x^2 + 1)), as in Replicate.R). Formation design, Compustat R&D (data_reg_rnd.rds). gvar g_form_m1 = formation fiscal year - 1 because the authors drop relative year -1 (see T2_c4); D equals TreatY x POST row by row. Sample as Replicate.R line 741: TimeFromY in {-5..-2, 0..3} | controls, treated cartels with share != 0 & power == 1 (data_cartel_strength_compustat.rds), minus exl as it stands at that line (the breakup-window singleton list assigned at Table 2 col 12; the formation-window list gives the identical estimate). Formula TreatY*POST: POST and TreatY:POST are collinear (POST = 0 for controls); felm reports the estimate on POST. Pipeline-sample TWFE (raw units) = 0.202640 vs authors 0.202640 (-0.00%). Unit id gid = 'g' + gvkey (one-to-one with gvkey): with the raw character gvkey (leading zeros, e.g. '001001'), fixest::sparse_model_matrix inside did2s names the FE '1001', 10,684 of 13,919 gvkey columns come out all-zero, the sparse solve fails and did2s falls back to a dense SVD that did not finish in 18 min; the prefix changes no estimate (TWFE/CSA unaffected; did2s point estimate unaffected, its SE was being computed on a corrupted first-stage matrix).
